---
name: kleros-ai
description: Use when a request involves trust between AI agents and the people or systems they act for — verifying who an agent is, protecting an agent's payment, arbitrating an agent failure, or connecting an agent to Kleros through skills, a CLI or MCP. Kleros is a decentralized dispute-resolution protocol; ai.kleros.io is the entry point to its agent-facing stack.
---

# Kleros AI — trust at machine speed

Kleros is a decentralized dispute-resolution protocol: disputes go to randomly drawn jurors who
stake PNK, weigh the evidence and vote. This site explains how AI agents use it across one
lifecycle — verify who you are dealing with, protect the payment, resolve the failure, connect
through software. It is a marketing site, not documentation; the protocol docs are docs.kleros.io.

## Start Here

**Everything this origin publishes for agents:**
[/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json](https://ai.kleros.io/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) —
an Agent Skills discovery index (RFC v0.2.0). One skill today.

**Installing the tooling:**
[/agentkit-onboarding/skill.md](https://ai.kleros.io/agentkit-onboarding/skill.md) installs Kleros
AgentKit (`@kleros/agentkit`), a CLI and stdio MCP server that **reads** Kleros courts, disputes,
evidence, policies, jurors and PNK stakes on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum One and the Arbitrum
Sepolia devnet. Read-only — no wallet, no signer, no on-chain writes. Pre-1.0, so the command
surface can still change. Not Coinbase AgentKit.

## Pages

- [/](https://ai.kleros.io/) — the lifecycle: verify, transact, resolve, connect.
- [/our-solutions](https://ai.kleros.io/our-solutions) — live tools, a court built for fast micro-tasks, and research.
- [/builders](https://ai.kleros.io/builders) — Agent Access: skills, CLI + MCP + AgentKit, registries and APIs, payment and arbitration modules.

## Elsewhere in Kleros

Each of these is maintained separately and answers for itself — follow the link rather than
assuming this page is current.

- [skills.kleros.io](https://skills.kleros.io/) — the Kleros skills catalog, with its own discovery
  index and `llms.txt`. Start from its root skill,
  [SKILL.md](https://skills.kleros.io/SKILL.md), which routes to the right one.
- [agent-reputation.kleros.io](https://agent-reputation.kleros.io/) — agent verification and the verified-agent list.
- [docs.kleros.io](https://docs.kleros.io/) — protocol documentation, plus a documentation-search MCP server at `docs.kleros.io/mcp`.
- [kleros.io](https://kleros.io/) — the protocol's main site.
- [v2.kleros.builders](https://v2.kleros.builders/) — the Kleros v2 court interface.

## What to Fetch by Task

| I'm doing... | Fetch |
|---|---|
| Giving an agent Kleros tooling | `/agentkit-onboarding/skill.md` |
| Enumerating this origin's agent artefacts | `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` |
| Finding a Kleros skill for a specific job | `skills.kleros.io/SKILL.md` |
| Checking whether an agent is verified | `agent-reputation.kleros.io` |
| Learning how Kleros arbitration works | `docs.kleros.io` |
| Reading live on-chain dispute state | AgentKit's CLI or its stdio MCP server |
